name: v1.2.0
body:
## What's Changed

This release focuses on making the app more reliable and easier to use in the field. It includes fixes for React rendering crashes, more resilient database validation and migrations, cleaner OpenSplitTime sync behavior, and better handling of CSV imports and RFID event resets. There were also UI improvements for data grids, text sizing, and upload status visibility.  The app now features an auto-update feature with automatic install for most platforms.

### Highlights
- Improved stability during rendering and startup, including recovery from unexpected errors instead of blanking the app window.
- Better database safety and validation, especially around schema checks, migration reliability, and status data handling.
- Improved OpenSplitTime integration, including stricter event configuration requirements, safer raw-time pushes, and regression coverage for bib correction logic.
- More reliable release automation and app updates, including GitHub release metadata and updater behavior.
- UI polish and usability fixes for high text size, grid layout, upload status headers, and optional trailing utility columns.

### Notable changes
- Fixed a React update loop in the backdrop system and improved crash recovery for route rendering.
- Added stronger CSV import error reporting and safer handling of malformed athlete data.
- Improved stats grid layout and reduced wasted horizontal space.
- Hardened release flow and GitHub metadata generation for app updates and deployment.
- Added regression tests covering OpenSplitTime bib corrections and database behavior.


## Change history

### Chore
- chore: trim narrating comments from earlier AI-assisted work by @cartpauj in PR #352
- chore: remove stale npm lockfile causing false Dependabot failures by @rleikis with @Copilot in PR #371

### Feature
- feat: add GitHub release auto updates by @rleikis in PR #373

### Fix
- fix(backdrop): stop backdrop registration from looping React updates by @cartpauj in PR #355
- fix(routes): recover from render errors instead of blanking the window by @cartpauj in PR #359
- Reduce Stats DataGrid horizontal waste by making trailing utility column optional by @rleikis with @Copilot in PR #370
- fix(main): stop blocking the ctrl minus text size shortcut by @cartpauj in PR #381
- fix(settings): wrap columns when they don't fit at high text size by @cartpauj in PR #383
- fix(datagrid): give the upload status header a background by @cartpauj in PR #385
- fix(drops-import): ignore millisecond precision when comparing drop timestamps by @rleikis in PR #387
- fix: await CSV exports before reporting success by @rleikis in PR #388
- fix: guard SetDrop against unavailable status database by @rleikis in PR #389
- fix(athlete-db): report malformed CSV import parsing errors by @rleikis in PR #390
- Require explicit RFID connection settings by @JordenLuke in PR #391
- Scrub renderer string dates by @rleikis in PR #392
- Fix station longitude readback by @rleikis in PR #393
- fix(database): validate schema before migrations by @rleikis in PR #394
- Clear RFID tables when clearing an event by @JordenLuke in PR #395
- fix(opensplittime): limit pushed raw-time kinds by @rleikis in PR #396
- Revert DataGrid useFlushSync: false workaround and restore virtualizer defaults by @rleikis with @Copilot in PR #397
- fix(opensplittime): remove bib correction push change by @rleikis in PR #399
- fix(opensplittime): require event configuration for login by @rleikis in PR #401
- fix: resolve lint warnings by @rleikis in PR #402
- fix(ci): make release metadata check portable by @rleikis in PR #404
- fix(ci): correct GitHub release auth and prerelease tags by @rleikis in PR #406
- fix(ci): disable publish during release builds by @rleikis in PR #409
- fix(ci): disable electron-builder publish on release builds by @rleikis in PR #410
- fix: restore electron-builder metadata generation by @rleikis in PR #411
- fix: generate release channel metadata by @rleikis in PR #412

### Test
- test(database): add OST bib correction regressions by @rleikis in PR #400

### Release
- Release v1.2.0: app updater, database reliability, OST sync, and UI improvements by @rleikis in PR #405

### Merge
- Merge release workflow fixes to main by @rleikis in PR #407

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/barcradio/ultra-tracker/compare/v1.1.0...v1.2.0

name: v1.0.2
body:
Release  - v1.0.2
Public release version of Ultra-tracker ahead of the Bear 100 2024 race.

Ensure you also download the event files (stations and athlete files) posted to:
https://bear100.groups.io/g/main/files

Development focus has been on the Windows client. If using other versions, please post issues to the GitHub project.

Report and discuss issues to [software@bear100.groups.io](mailto:software@bear100.groups.io)
---
## Change log
### Features
* Add application version to title bar
### Fixes
* Fixed issue found when loading the stations table, but not athletes and then reopening the app
* Fixed an issue where input of same bib with opposite time was failing
* Fixed an issue where the stats did not recalculate if DNS or DNF were set via the Edit drawer
* Improved tag colors between light/dark modes
* Moved database files to userdata directory instead of the application directory
  * On Windows `.\appdata\roaming\ultra-tracker\event-databases`
* Fixed where null notes were getting into the export files
* Append `yyyy-MM-dd-` to diagnostic log filename to ensure file sizes stay manageable
* Keep toast open for unknown athlete timings

name: v1.0.1
body:
Release  - v1.0.1 
First public release version of Ultra-tracker ahead of the Bear 100 2024 race.

Ensure you also download the event files (stations and athlete files) posted to:
https://bear100.groups.io/g/software/files

Development focus has been on the Windows client. If using other versions, please post issues to the GitHub project.

Report and discuss issues to [software@bear100.groups.io](mailto:software@bear100.groups.io)

## Changelog
### Features
* Added button on Export folder that opens the `%userprofile%\Documents\ultra-tracker` folder
* Changed DNF column on Stats Page to Status, added DNS and Duplicate tags and filters
* Added Status column to Roster page
  * added In, Out, DNS, Medical, Withdrew, Timeout, and Incoming tags and filters;
  * Incoming is intentionally blank, but is a filter option
* Added Unknown Bibs result to count records with bibs not in athlete list
* Added warning notifications after entering an unknown or duplicate bib
* Changed Notes field so that commas are automatically replaced with allowed semi-colons
* Added more vertical space to Notes field on Edit drawer
* Added button to jump to athlete on Roster Page from Edit drawer
* Added feature to backup the local database on 5 minute interval
* Added button layout to Settings Page
* Added RFID system integration that will be used by the Bear100 event
* Changed RFID button to be used by Start and Finish line stations only
* Added automatic enforcement of Station entry modes from stations file as defined by race leaderships
  * Normal mode allows In, Out, and In/Out timings
  * Fast Mode processes all timings as In/Out mode
    * Out times may be updated for lingering runners at an aid station
* Added links back to Table of Contents and improved readability and page layout for most aspect ratios
### Fixes
* Fixed Javascript runtime exceptions encountered when importing files with the wrong CSV format
* Fixed sorting and grid layout on Stations page
* Fixed many cases of for duplicate and status handling from new features
* Fixed issues where editing runners to a duplicate was clearing statuses of good records
